_source: GDD §6.7, §12.1a; Demo Specification §8.5, §8.8 (stage 5b, approved 2026-11-13). All numbers provisional. contact_morale_penalty 10 -> 4 (user decision 2026-11-15): contact still frightens but is worth less than well-timed harm, so it is not a scare to farm. search_base_minutes 10 -> 4 (user decision 2026-11-15): a calm searcher checks only the spot nearest the sighting; anxious or unhappy ones search longer. Energy penalties for being seen live in energy.json (stage 5d); the game passes them in as energy_penalty. glance (user decision 2026-11-15): resting people glance to a random side every every_minutes (game minutes, divided by their anxiety; divided by focused_factor during focused_activities or any repair job), for duration_minutes, up to max_angle_deg either side; seeded.
